name: Bala Lake
text: Bala Lake is a stretch of still water in the north of Wales. It is the widest sheet of fresh water in the country. The town at its edge takes its name from a place where a river runs out. The name lives on in the speech and the maps of Wales.

attributes.attribute: a source of the river Dee

okr.objective: Record the great lake of Wales.
key_results: Give its place as a river source.
